Question: mera nam arshad hi, mane pahele anjane mi phir janbughkar sharab pe hi, mi janta hu yah gunah hi. lekin yesa huaa hi.lekin ab mane toba kar le hi, kyaa allah mughe maaf karega,ya phir mi iske liye kyaa karoo, kyo ki bhool to hui hi, pls batay. Answer ID: 10382 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 151/140=B/1429) You should regret committing this sinful act and resolve firmly not to repeat it again in future. Then, repent to Allah earnestly; it is pertaining to the rights related to Allah and in-shaAllah it shall be forgiven. One who repents to Allah, Allah purges away the sins as if he never committed it: التائب من الذنب کمن لا ذنب لہ One who repents to Allah is as if he did not commit the sin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
